_comment: Open places layer catalog (Overture Maps Places, CDLA-Permissive 2.0), baked per region by tools/build-places-region.sh on the places-overlays workflow. bbox=[S,W,N,E]. Mirrors the obf region catalog (obf-manifest-staging.json, 414 rows: US states, Canadian provinces, German Laender, French/Spanish/Italian regions, countries) so a region download finds its places archives by bbox; a whole-country download on the older routing catalog pulls every archive whose center falls inside it. davis is the small test box. The workflow's matrix is capped at 256 jobs, so the full bake runs as two shards.
